items.headline: OpenAI raises GPT-6.1 Sol default context to 500K tokens in Codex and ChatGPT Work
items.summary: Day 7 of OpenAI's 28-day improvement campaign. Codex head Thibault Sottiaux said the default context for GPT-6.1 Sol jumped from 272K to 500K tokens, about an 80% increase. The change reduces compaction interruptions during long coding sessions.
items.why: Compaction, where Codex summarizes older context to free space, breaks flow on large projects. Doubling the default lets developers keep more of a codebase in view without hitting the wall, and OpenAI says it will go higher still.

items.headline: DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus solves 9 open Erdos problems; Science paper highlights peer review gap
items.summary: Built on Gemini 3.1 Pro and the Lean proof verifier, AlphaProof Nexus solved 9 of 353 open Erdos problems (two unsolved for 56 years) and proved 44 OEIS conjectures. The Decoder contrasts DeepMind's peer-reviewed Science paper with OpenAI's unreviewed math dump.

items.headline: Leak: Gemini 4 Argon appears in user A/B tests, routing through other model names
items.summary: TestingCatalog reports X users are seeing Argon outputs through A/B tests on Google's Antigravity platform. Side-by-side comparisons suggest improved front-end design quality over Gemini 3.8 Flash. Google has not confirmed wider access.

items.headline: Community speculation: Claude may be routing to a stronger checkpoint, possibly Fable 5.5
items.summary: Multiple X users report Claude responses appear markedly stronger, speculating Anthropic is quietly routing some requests to a new checkpoint. Anthropic has not announced any new model. The current Fable is version 5.1.
